dietitian.bio: I guide clients toward lasting health goals with evidence-based nutrition and sustainable habits. Every metabolism, lifestyle, and preference is unique—so every plan I create is built around you.

online.title: Online Nutrition Coaching
online.description: Video consultation, a personalized meal plan, and weekly online follow-up.
online.longDescription: An end-to-end online coaching package designed for busy professionals and clients outside the city. In the first session we dig into your goals, health history, and lifestyle—then I build a nutrition plan just for you. Weekly check-ins and messaging support keep progress on track together.
online.audience: Remote clients, busy professionals, and anyone who prefers at-home coaching

process.3: Stay on track with weekly follow-ups

klinik.title: In-Clinic Consultation
klinik.description: Detailed body analysis, measurements, and one-on-one coaching in a clinical setting.
klinik.longDescription: A comprehensive in-person session at the Kadıköy clinic. We start with body composition analysis, anthropometric measurements, and a lifestyle review. By the end of the session you’ll leave with a sustainable nutrition strategy and a clear follow-up plan.
klinik.audience: First-time clients, those who want detailed measurements, and anyone who prefers face-to-face coaching

sporcu.title: Sports Nutrition
sporcu.description: Training-cycle macro planning and performance-focused nutrition strategies.
sporcu.longDescription: A package built for athletes chasing performance, muscle gain, or competition prep. Macro and micronutrient targets are planned around your training load, sport, and phase goals. Pre- and post-workout fueling plus recovery strategies are part of the program.
sporcu.audience: Active athletes, fitness enthusiasts, and competition or performance prep

1.quote: I lost 12 kg in 3 months—and the best part is I did it without starving, enjoying every step. Selin was with me the whole way.

2.quote: With a nutrition plan built around my training, I lowered my body fat and saw a clear jump in performance.

3.quote: Online coaching kept me consistent even with a packed work schedule. The recipes are practical and delicious!

4.quote: I wanted lasting habits—not just weight loss. This program was exactly what I needed.
